title: ColorPalette
description: Fiori predefined color palette with the UI5 five-column keyboard model, default color and local recent colors.

usage.summary: Choose a predefined color from swatches kept visible in the page.
useWhen: Let users choose from predefined colors while keeping the swatches visible.
Keep each swatch tied to its fixed color rather than changing it with the theme.
Enable showDefaultColor, showRecentColors or showMoreColors only when those choices are allowed.

avoidWhen.when: Show predefined colors only after opening a contextual chooser.
Choose an arbitrary color or enter its channel values directly.
